title: Awesome Agent Clients
subtitle: A better workspace for the agents you already use.
description: Desktop, terminal, mobile, and web clients for coding agents, organized by how you work.
scope: Interfaces that run, steer, review, or resume an existing coding-agent harness. General chat frontends and standalone agent frameworks belong elsewhere.
questions: Which agent harnesses and authentication methods does it support?
Where does the agent execute: your machine, a server you manage, or a hosted environment?
Can you review diffs, approve actions, and resume work from another device?
